meta.title: Static Site Generator: Coffee Shop
meta.description: Load the BrewCommerce coffee shop demo and install the static site generator.
meta.author: Adam Zielinski

steps.code:
<?php
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
}

update_option( 'blog_public', '1' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon_enabled', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_pages_only', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_task_list_hidden', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_task_list_complete', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_opt_in', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_allow_tracking', 'no' );
update_option(
	'woocommerce_onboarding_profile',
	array(
		'completed' => true,
		'skipped'   => true,
	)
);
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
delete_option( '_wc_activation_redirect' );

if ( defined( 'WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR' ) && wp_mkdir_p( WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR ) ) {
	file_put_contents(
		WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR . '/brewcommerce-public-store.php',
		"<?php\nadd_filter( 'woocommerce_coming_soon_exclude', '__return_true', PHP_INT_MAX );\n"
	);
}
